readme.markdown:
# BotFactory MCP Farm

Hosted MCP servers on [MCPize](https://mcpize.com) — zero-auth public APIs, freemium x402 (USDC on Base).

## Catalog

See [CATALOG.md](./CATALOG.md) for the full list with gateway URLs.

## Connect

```
https://<slug>.mcpize.run/mcp
```

Requires an x402-capable MCP client for paid tools. `health_check` and discovery tools are free.

## Awesome list entries

See [AWESOME_ENTRIES.md](./AWESOME_ENTRIES.md).

toolsPreview.name: get_exchange_rates
toolsPreview.description:
Get official NBU (National Bank of Ukraine) exchange rates.
    date format: YYYYMMDD or None for today. Returns: {rates, date, source}

toolsPreview.name: search_prozorro_tenders
toolsPreview.description:
Search Ukrainian public procurement tenders on Prozorro.
    Returns: {tenders: [{title, value, status, date_modified}]}

toolsPreview.name: geocode_ukraine
toolsPreview.description:
Geocode Ukrainian address to coordinates using OpenStreetMap Nominatim.
    Returns: {lat, lon, display_name, region, city}

toolsPreview.name: get_weather_ukraine
toolsPreview.description:
Get current weather for Ukrainian city using Open-Meteo (free, no auth).
    Returns: {temperature_c, windspeed, weathercode, city}
